## Spotify to Add 'AI Persona' Badges on AI-Generated Artist Profiles Starting September

Spotify's voluntary labeling policy signals management awareness of AI-content saturation and the creator/listener trust dynamic — a real platform-integrity risk as AI music scales. It also sets a precedent other streaming and content platforms may be pressured to follow, with downstream implications for AI content monetization economics.

- Spotify will introduce a badge system to mark AI-generated artist profiles, rolling out from September.
- Policy targets transparency around AI-created identities and content on the platform.
- Represents a proactive disclosure step as AI-generated music proliferates on streaming platforms.
- No detail on enforcement mechanism, volume of affected profiles, or regulatory driver is given in the headline.
